label: q at original position 3-5 after n/z, in sequences starting with p (or t)
explanation: Very sparse conjunction feature (0.005% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at t=3-5 (peak t=4), and almost only in sequences whose first token is p (87% of mass; t gets 11%). The strongest activations land on input q (59% of mass) right after n or z (prev/prev2 n or z), e.g. p p n n [q]. With the same context it fires more weakly on other tokens. Never fires in the copy phase and barely at the delimiter. The context alone (first p/t, t 3-5, n/z in the last two inputs) covers about 80% of mass but has about 2% precision, so a large unmodeled factor decides when it fires. Adding in_tok==q pushes precision to about 27% but cuts recall to about 27%.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=p (+5.49), prev_tok=n (+3.13), orig1=t (+2.65), orig1=p (+2.34), prev_tok=z (+2.05), orig0=t (+2.00). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.50), orig_idx=-1 (-1.47), orig4=w (-1.43), phase=2 (-1.42).
